FISHING LICENCE · SWITZERLAND

Switzerland fishing licence

Fishing permissions depend on the canton and the chosen water.

Visitor licence fromCHF 321 day
Go to the official site ↗Checked against official sources on 20 Nov 2026.

1Who needs a fishing licence in Switzerland?

You need a licence

  • Visitors must meet the permit and qualification requirements for the canton and water.
  • In Bern, non-residents can buy cantonal fishing permits.

2Which licence can you buy?

  • 1 dayCHF 32Canton of Bern day permit (Tagespatent)
  • 7 daysCHF 100Canton of Bern week permit (Wochenpatent)
  • 30 daysCHF 360Canton of Bern month permit, non-resident of the canton (SaNa needed)
  • Calendar yearCHF 500Canton of Bern year permit, non-resident of the canton (SaNa needed, plus CHF 50 conservation fee)

Prices from the official source, checked 20 Nov 2026.

3Extra stamps and permits

  • Leased-water permissionFor water where the fishing rights belong to a leaseholder, such as Zurich fishing districts.

4Where can you get the licence?

Buy the permit of the canton or leased fishery where you fish. Example Canton of Bern: its official web shop (efj-shop.apps.be.ch), the Fischen Bern app or one of 30+ agents; month and year permits need the SaNa certificate.

Go to the official site ↗

5Rules to know before you fish

  • In Bern, permits for 30 days or longer require recognised fishing competence proof.
  • In Bern, short-permit anglers without that proof must read the official fish-welfare information.
  • Follow the permit's water boundaries and cantonal fishing rules.

More detail

What to confirm before the trip

Confirm fees, SaNa or foreign-qualification acceptance, free-fishing exceptions and guide requirements with the chosen canton.

Do I need a fishing licence in Switzerland?

Fishing permissions depend on the canton and the chosen water.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Switzerland?

Canton of Bern day permit (Tagespatent): CHF 32; Canton of Bern week permit (Wochenpatent): CHF 100; Canton of Bern month permit, non-resident of the canton (SaNa needed): CHF 360; Canton of Bern year permit, non-resident of the canton (SaNa needed, plus CHF 50 conservation fee): CHF 500 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Switzerland?

Buy the permit of the canton or leased fishery where you fish. Example Canton of Bern: its official web shop (efj-shop.apps.be.ch), the Fischen Bern app or one of 30+ agents; month and year permits need the SaNa certificate.
